title: Super Bowl XLIII
overview: Super Bowl XLIII, played on February 1, 2009, at Raymond James Stadium in Tampa, delivered one of the most thrilling finishes in Super Bowl history as the Pittsburgh Steelers defeated the Arizona Cardinals 27-23. The game featured a historic defensive play, a late-game comeback, and a final-minute touchdown drive that cemented the Steelers’ legacy as the NFL’s most successful franchise at the time.
